conviction_note: The print is real and confirmed three ways, but it is not in the window I am asked to predict: Philogen releases board-approved results after the Milan close, so the close(22-Sep)->close(23-Sep) window contains a normal trading session and no print. Sizing on this name's own reaction distribution for exactly that session -- 12 observed board dates off the issuer's published Italian calendars -- gives mean +0.04%, median 0.00%, 5/12 positive, so the signed answer is zero with a genuinely wide band (observed D0 range -2.42% to +2.73%). print_vs_bar is -2.0 and expected_move is 0.0 because a fundamental read cannot reach a window the release is not in; on the amc window the resolver also measures, my estimate would be about +0.3 with a band of -1.0 to +1.3.
bar: Effectively UNSOURCED, and every size here is capped accordingly. No H1-2026 consensus revenue or EPS is published anywhere for this name; the three covering houses are Mediobanca, Goldman Sachs and Stifel (https://www.philogen.com/investors/analyst-coverage/) and none publishes estimates publicly. The only sourced anchors are company-stated: net financial position +EUR 355,441k at 31-Mar-2026 and +EUR 368,295k at 31-Dec-2025 (https://www.philogen.com/documentation/PR/20260512_The_Board_of_Directors_approves_the_financial_position_for_the_first_quarter_of_2026.pdf), the H1-2025 comparatives of EUR 5,502k revenue from contracts / EUR 8,721k total revenue, EBITDA -EUR 13,869k, net loss -EUR 14,894k, NFP +EUR 88,525k (https://www.philogen.com/documentation/PR/20250923_Approval_Half-Yearly_Financial_Report_at_30_June%202025_(Price_Sensitive)-Courtesy_English_Translation.pdf), and the EUR 28,180,796 dividend paid 20-May-2026. Against a dividend-adjusted NFP bar of roughly EUR 310-318m the print should land near it; against the EUR 355m figure the market last saw in a headline it lands ~12% below, which is where the -2.0 comes from.

Corroborated by volume: on 9 of 12 observed board dates the session AFTER the board day carried more volume than the board day itself (e.g. FY-2025: 17,145 shares on 27-Mar vs 68,410 on 30-Mar). positioning_check: No positioning anchor exists for this name. CONSOB's posizioni nette corte register was read successfully on 2026-09-21 (48 disclosed positions) and does not name Philogen, so short_ratio_pct 0.0 is the 0.5%-of-capital truncation floor and NOT a measurement of this issuer -- 0.4% and 0.0% are recorded identically. anchor_covered is false, state register_read_no_position, so per LESSONS.md the baseline's priced_lean_pct of +0.095 IS its run-up term (lean_components: short_squeeze 0.0, short_building 0.0, runup +0.095) and is therefore the same object as the free control this stage has to beat -- nothing I found can beat the benchmark by agreeing with it. Building vs covering is unknowable: CONSOB publishes the current position only and the issuer is absent from it. Separately, internal dealing is silent -- the issuer's register's most recent entry is 05/02/2026, seven months before this print (https://www.philogen.com/investors/internal-dealing/). And the buyback is immaterial as a technical bid: Mediobanca bought 230 shares in the whole of July 2026, in 4 transactions at EUR 22.80, against a 20-day median volume near 11,000 shares (https://www.philogen.com/documentation/Shareholders/Luglio_2026_Aggiornamento_sul_programma_di_acquisto_mensile_di_azioni_proprie_(Allegato_3F).pdf).

findings.finding: Philogen puts its board-approved results on the tape at roughly 19:00 CET, after the 17:30 Euronext Milan close, so the scored close(22-Sep)->close(23-Sep) window contains no print at all -- the baseline's defaulted `bmo` is wrong and the release lands about 90 minutes after the window shuts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Every prior instance of this line behaves the same way: the board day itself is quiet and the NEXT session carries both the move and the volume. FY-2025 (record profit, first dividend): +2.73% on 17,145 shares on the board day 27-Mar-2026, then -0.88% on 68,410 shares on 30-Mar. H1-2025: +0.87% on 15,992 then +0.43% on 27,357. Q1-2026: +1.15% on 10,050 then +0.68% on 19,352. The volume spike is on D+1 in 9 of 12 observed board dates.

findings.why_not_priced: This is not a fact the price can reflect -- it is a fact about which price is being measured, and the vendor calendar that seeds this run does not carry it (session_unresolved: true, defaulted to bmo). If the market thought a market-moving release were due before or during the 23-Sep session, the 21-22 September tape would show anticipation; instead volume was 6,896 and 10,104 shares against a 20-day median near 11,000, i.e. BELOW normal, and the stock closed -0.64% on 22-Sep. Nobody is positioning for a 23-Sep-session event because there is not one.
findings.independence: Three independent confirmations of the 19:00-ish release time on three different releases, plus the volume asymmetry computed from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/PHIL.MI?range=3y&interval=1d), plus the webinar cadence: the H1-2025 results webinar was 26-Sep-2025, three days after the 23-Sep-2025 board, and the 2026 analogue is scheduled for 25-Sep-2026 (https://www.philogen.com/investors/webinars/). Also https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2025/09/23/philogen-ricavi-ed-ebitda-in-miglioramento-nel-primo-semestre-251.html (19.40) and https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/05/12/philogen-pfn-positiva-a-355-milioni-di-euro-al-termine-del-primo-trimestre-229.html (18.58).

findings.why_not_priced: It is not that the market has mispriced this -- it is that the ONE input this stage ranks on for this name, `history.median_abs_move_pct`, is built from dates that never happened, and no vendor publishes the real ones. Four Philogen board dates are recoverable only from the Italian-language calendar PDFs for 2023 and 2024, which exist in no English source and are not indexed by any results calendar. If the market expected a 1.9% move on 23-Sep the stock would carry some anticipation premium; realised 20-day vol is 18.3% (a 1.15% one-day move) and the last two sessions traded below median volume.
findings.independence: Rests on DIFFERENT documents from finding 1 -- four issuer calendar PDFs (2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) joined to the Yahoo daily bars, where finding 1 rests on three Teleborsa wire timestamps. The 2023 and 2024 board dates are corroborated independently by https://www.philogen.com/documentation/Financial_Calendar/Calendario_Finanziario_2023_(ITA).pdf and https://www.philogen.com/philogen/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Calendario_Finanziario_2024.pdf, and the forward 23-Sep-2026 date by Borsa Italiana's own CdA list.

outside_window.finding: The outcome of the Parallel Scientific Advice meeting Philogen scheduled with EMA and FDA for June 2026, to align on the new Phase III in first-line soft-tissue sarcoma for Fibromun, has never been separately disclosed -- no comunicato of any kind between 12-May-2026 and 27-Jul-2026 -- and the half-year report is its natural venue. Original: 'Per quanto riguarda Fibromun, nel sarcoma dei tessuti molli di prima linea abbiamo pianificato per il mese di giugno un Parallel Scientific Advice con EMA e FDA per allineamento sul nuovo studio di Fase III'. Direction genuinely unknown, so the point estimate is zero and the band is what matters: Philogen's clinical/regulatory line is the one that actually moves this stock (+4.75% on 27-Jul-2026 on the Nidlegy MAA resubmission, +3.61% on 19-Aug-2026 around the JCO publication) against a median 0.94% on the results line. Lands on the amc reaction session, not the scored bmo one.

The headline net financial position will step down to roughly EUR 310-318m at 30-Jun-2026 from the EUR 355.4m the market last saw at 31-Mar-2026 -- about two thirds of the fall is the EUR 28,180,796 dividend paid 20-May-2026 (EUR 0.70/share, ex 18-May) and the rest is roughly EUR 13m a quarter of operating burn. Philogen leads every release with this number and Teleborsa headlines it verbatim ('PFN positiva a 355 milioni'), so the wire headline on 23-Sep evening will read materially lower than the last one. Known to the three covering houses, plausibly not to the retail base that sets the marginal price in a EUR 0.4m/day name. Lands on the amc session.

The resubmitted Nidlegy MAA (filed 27-Jul-2026, 33-month median follow-up vs 21 in the withdrawn June-2024 dossier) is the real driver of this equity, and EMA's own record still shows only the WITHDRAWN application, whose provisional CHMP view was that Nidlegy 'could not have been authorised', on manufacturing and quality grounds rather than efficacy. Whether the CMC package was fixed is the question that matters for this name and it does not resolve on 23-Sep or 24-Sep; CHMP opinion timing is many months out.

searched_and_found_nothing: eMarket STORAGE DOES NOT CARRY PHILOGEN, and this is the single most important reachability result of this first Italian hunt. A fulltext query (https://www.emarketstorage.com/it/comunicati-finanziari?cerca=Philogen&data_from=01/06/2026&data_to=23/09/2026) returned HTTP 200 with zero result rows, and the site's own `azienda` issuer dropdown contains no PHILOGEN entry -- it runs PHARMANUTRA -> PIAGGIO & C. -> PIERREL. Italy has several authorised storage mechanisms and Borsa Italiana's OAM is not universal. This is a LIVE DEFECT for eu_resolve.py: an Italian confirmation path that reads only eMarket STORAGE will find nothing for Philogen and could write event_occurred: false on a name that did report -- the mirror image of the TRT error. Two cheap substitutes both worked first time: Borsa Italiana's own forward board-meeting PDF (https://www.borsaitaliana.it/azioni/documenti/calendariobilancidividendi/CDA_today.pdf) which names '23/09/2026 - PHILOGEN Relazione Semestrale', and the per-ISIN news list (https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/azioni/elenco-completo-notizie.html?isin=IT0005373789).

eu_pdftext.py CANNOT READ THE NUMBERS IN ITALIAN ISSUER PRESS RELEASES, and it fails silently, which is worse than failing. It extracts only literal (...) strings from content streams; Philogen sets every headline figure in a bold subset font emitted as HEX strings <...>, so the FY2025 release came back as fluent English prose with 'Net Profit for the period of ___ thousand' and the H1-2025 release with 'Revenues ... amounted to ___ thousand' -- every euro figure a blank. A ~40-line extension that walks the ToUnicode CMaps (beginbfchar/beginbfrange) and decodes hex strings recovered all of them exactly (EUR 229,681k net profit, EUR 368,295k NFP, EUR 314,325k revenue, EUR 5,502k H1-2025 revenue, EUR 88,525k H1-2025 NFP), each cross-checked against the independent Teleborsa write-up. Working script left at /tmp/pdfhex.py; it belongs in eu_pdftext.py.

Reachability, this container, 2026-09-22: philogen.com, borsaitaliana.it and teleborsa.it all answered on the first try for HTML; philogen.com PDF downloads hit a connection reset on 2 of ~14 requests and succeeded on retry with a 2-3s backoff, consistent with the documented ~7-of-8 pattern -- retry, do not conclude blocked. emarketstorage.com answered 200 on the first try both times (its problem here is coverage, not the WAF). CONSOB was not re-fetched; the baseline had already read the register.
baseline_tension: It neither agrees nor disagrees with the lean, because the lean is not an independent object for this name -- anchor_covered is false, so priced_lean_pct (+0.095) is its run-up term alone and is the same number as the free control; what I found cuts against the baseline's SCALE instead, replacing a cadence-estimated 1.9% event proxy with a measured 0.00% median for the session actually being scored.
local_pass_note: The Italian pass reversed the sign of the whole hunt. The English pass had the session as probably-bmo-ish and unresolved; three Teleborsa article pages, which carry a CET publication timestamp that no English source reproduces, put three consecutive Philogen results releases at 19.40, 19.41 and 18.58 CET and settled it as amc. That alone moved expected_move from +0.5 to 0.0, because the print is not in the scored window.

It DESTROYED my largest English-pass finding (+0.8). In English I could only see the four most recent board dates, all of which had positive board-day moves (+0.87, +1.68, +2.73, +1.15), and I sized a real anticipation drift. The Italian `Calendario degli eventi societari` PDFs for 2023 and 2024 -- which exist in no English version -- added eight more observations and the full sample is mean +0.04%, median 0.00%, 5/12 positive. A four-observation artefact.

It killed the buyback lead. English gave me only 'THE BOARD APPROVED THE LAUNCH OF A SHARE BUYBACK PROGRAM' from the 12-May courtesy translation, which on a EUR 0.4m/day tape looked like it could be a material bid. The Italian Annex 3F monthly return shows 230 shares in the whole of July 2026, and the Italian press release gives the cap (300,000 shares / EUR 6.9m to Oct-2027) and the independent-intermediary structure. Immaterial.

It supplied numbers English could not. The Teleborsa write-ups independently carry every figure that eu_pdftext.py silently dropped from the English courtesy-translation PDFs, and gave the total dividend (EUR 28,180,796), the payment date (20-May-2026), the treasury holding (362,799 shares = 0.8933%) and the verbatim Italian on the June EMA/FDA Parallel Scientific Advice.
It re-sized the NFP finding from -0.4 to -0.3 and moved it OUT of findings into outside_window, because the amc result means the H1 numbers land after the scored window closes.
It found the event-confirmation defect: eMarket STORAGE, the source this stage's Italian confirmation path is built on, does not carry this issuer at all.
lessons_applied: Widened both bands hard, from about +/-0.4 to -1.8/+1.9. 'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error ... size on the name's own reaction distribution' plus 'the tail is intact, so do not size as if it were not' -- the observed board-day distribution runs -2.42% to +2.73%, so a narrow band around a zero point estimate was false precision. The POINT estimate stayed at 0.0, because sizing on this name's own distribution for this session is what produces zero.

Rewrote positioning_check to say explicitly that with anchor_covered false the priced_lean IS the free control, so nothing here can beat the benchmark by agreeing with it. The file states this and my draft had only said the register does not name Philogen.

Confirmed the outside_window split rather than changing it. 'Keep findings inside the exit window ... here the window is one session for a bmo name, so this bites harder' is precisely the consequence of my own amc result: every statement about the CONTENT of the print resolves on 24-Sep and belongs outside.

The file's first Europe-specific rule -- 'if your baseline says session_unresolved, spend one search settling it before you size anything; it is worth more than any finding you will make' -- retroactively endorsed the centrepiece, and its Barratt Redrow example (+11.72% bmo vs +1.78% amc) is why I did not hedge the session call.

Checked the 'a filing before the print may have pre-released the number' rule against the Italian analogue and recorded the negative result explicitly in searched_and_found_nothing rather than leaving it unstated.

Did NOT let the '3-7 analysts means nobody is positioned' rule inflate anything: the three names here are Mediobanca, Goldman Sachs and Stifel, so the band understates coverage quality, and in any case my result is that the event is outside the window, not that a fact is unpriced.
